sn40.3:1.4: idha bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
sn40.3:1.6: so khvāhaṃ āvuso pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharāmi sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedemi yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn40.3:1.7: tassa mayhaṃ āvuso iminā vihārena viharato pītisahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.
sn40.3:2.1: atha kho maṃ āvuso bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca
sn40.3:2.3: mā brāhmaṇa tatiyajjhānaṃ pamādo tatiyajjhāne cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi tatiyajjhāne cittaṃ ekodiṃ karohi tatiyajjhāne cittaṃ samādahāti.
sn40.3:2.4: so khvāhaṃ āvuso aparena samayena pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharāmi sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedemi yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
sn40.3:2.5: yaṃ hi taṃ āvuso sammā vadamāno vadeyya …pe… mahābhiññataṃ pattoti.
